tools.name: Microsoft Copilot
tools.quote: The University’s provided AI tool is Microsoft Copilot. This is available to all staff and students, with ‘Commercial Data Protection’ services enabled.

tools.name: Grammarly
tools.quote: Grammarly has optional Generative AI features that aid the production of new content based on a series of prompts. These features should be disabled when writing assessments unless expressly permitted by your module co-ordinator or permitted as a reasonable adjustment by the Disability Team in Student Services.

data.quote: AI may capture data from input prompts, so it is important not to submit personal or sensitive information to an AI tool.

safeguards.quote: AI may capture data from input prompts, so it is important not to submit personal or sensitive information to an AI tool. The University Data Protection Policy can be accessed here.
